doctrine: The turn is the plan (owner directive 2026-08-09): a session ends only when every item is done or a valid stop reason is recorded (user-stop, irreversible, external-prereq). Deferral to fresh context is NOT a stop reason. cmd/plan owns dispatch bookkeeping; the continuation rule itself lives in skill.md and is followed, not hook-enforced (hook wiring is the owner's environment decision). Owner directive 2026-08-09: (a) per-rung validation is head-to-head -- run the adaptive_new and overgo implementations on the same artifact and inputs, adopt whichever component structures measure better, overgo ends at-or-below on wall+memory; (b) multimodal capabilities are tested when applicable -- image, video, and audio rungs exercise real modality inputs drawn from the repodb dataset catalog (adaptive_new docs/repodb datasets.log; resolved via the dataroot contract), never synthetic-only.

parity_finding.evidence: ID-level greedy parity vs torch golden: step 0 matches all 3 cases; divergence at steps 1-3. Prefill A/B reproduces decode exactly (internal consistency), so the forward itself differs. Live cross-check: adaptive-native CUDA serving on the same prompts AGREES WITH TORCH on all three (TTTTTT+GTGTGT-runs / AAAAAA-runs); overgo picks ATGCGT where both say GTGTGT, and case 3 step 3 emits ASCII token 27 against a 2.1-logit reference gap -- too large for rounding.
parity_finding.microscope: dump overgo top-8 logits at the mismatch steps (add a debug top-logits output to the generation path or a one-shot logits CLI) and diff against the torch per-step top_ids/top_logits already in the golden: near-tie reordering with close values => precision structure (then compare host f32-accum choices vs reference); a wildly-off single token => weight/embedding mapping defect in the converter (check DNA-band embed rows byte-identity between safetensors and GGUF).
